title: [3.x] oversized Editor Color Picker when gui/theme/use_hidpi is enabled in Project Settings
body:
### Tested versions

- v3.6.stable.official [de2f0f147]
- v3.x [009e0c576babfc40be0d6c7ed43a79de467eed6e]

### System information

Godot v3.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100), Fedora 40 workstation, Ubuntu 24.04.1 , GLES3 - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7283) - AMD Ryzen 5 7640HS w/ Radeon 760M Graphics (12 threads)

### Issue description

When enabling `gui/theme/use_hidpi` in the Project Settings, the Editor Color Picker becomes significantly larger.

since `gui/theme/use_hidpi` is a project settings, I think it's should not directly affect the editor UI itself.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e9ee8a89-78ed-439a-841e-483360a45b66)

---

I only manage to find a workaround mainly by adding code below on `color_picker.cpp` (and some adjustment):

```c++
	if (GLOBAL_GET("gui/theme/use_hidpi")) {
		sv_size = Size2(get_constant("sv_width"), get_constant("sv_height")) / 2;
		h_width = Size2(get_constant("h_width"), 0) / 2;
	}
```

I believe there is proper fix to this, but I can open PR with this workaround if needed


### Steps to reproduce

- Create New project
- Enable `gui/theme/use_hidpi` in the Project Settings
- Restart the editor

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[hidpi_color_picker.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19852116/hidpi_color_picker.zip)
